deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that since Shopify is not explicitly detected, we will provide Shopify-specific instructions as the default guide.
To embed a returns reason capture form into a Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Apps".
2. Click on "Manage private apps" and then click on "Create app".
3. Fill in the required information for the new app, such as name and API scopes.
4. In the "API scopes" section, select "Read and write orders" and "Read and write customers".
5. Click on "Save" to create the new app.
6. Go back to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Apps".
7. Find the newly created app in the list of installed apps and click on it.
8. In the app settings, scroll down to the "API keys" section and click on "Create API key".
9. Select the necessary permissions for the API key (in this case, "Read and write orders" and "Read and write customers").
10. Click on "Save" to create the API key.
11. In your returns reason capture form code, replace the placeholder API key with the actual API key generated in step 9.
12. Make sure to handle errors and exceptions properly when submitting the returns reason capture form data to Shopify's API.
13. Test the embedded returns reason capture form thoroughly to ensure it works as expected.
